title: Compatible finite tensor coordinates for normalized geometric pullback
statement: Fix Base b and Geometry g for f:X→Y [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. Suppose every levelPushUnderlying comparison acts identically on sections. For all actual coefficient systems M,N and n, there are finite isomorphisms from the n-th evaluation of g.pull(tensorRight N M) to that of tensorRight (g.pull N) (g.pull M) [def-sfb-tower-class-tensor-pullback]. These commute with quotient transitions and are natural in M. The finite constant-ring adjoint of ordinaryPullEvaluation.inv followed by this comparison sends a pure tensor x tensor y to the pure tensor of sectionAdjoint(id)(x) and sectionAdjoint(id)(y). The result is finite-level: it does not supply a system natural isomorphism.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: Use finite-limit preservation of the set-valued pro-etale inverse image and apply geometricOrdinaryTensor_exists to the ordinary fields of g.generic. Use comparison(g,T) to conjugate its existing natural system tensor comparison by the explicit-site/monoidal tensor bridges and transport to the given actual coefficient coordinates. Define delta(M,N,n) by evaluation of this constructed system isomorphism.

Naturality of the ordinary horizontal transition with respect to the constructed system comparison is precisely the required horizontal equation after reversing its sides. Apply evaluation to the naturality equation for comparison(g,T,N) to obtain naturality in M.
Apply the finite adjunction normalization of the explicitly constructed comparison. Its statement is exactly the final sectionwise clause for these evaluated isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: clause (2): reuse the existing ordinary system comparison, then evaluate

theorem exists_tensorLevelCoordinates {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E}
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (hpush : ∀ (n : ℕ)
      (N : SemilinearSections.Mod.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (g.generic.coefficients n)) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((SemilinearSections.underlying.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n)).obj
          ((g.generic.levelPush n).obj N)).obj.obj U),
      HEq (((g.generic.levelPushUnderlying n).hom.app N).hom.app U x) x) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ (M N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)) (n : ℕ),
      (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj (g.pull.obj ((tensorRight l E Y N).obj M)) ≅
        (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj
          ((tensorRight l E X (g.pull.obj N)).obj (g.pull.obj M)),
      (∀ (M N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
        (SemilinearSections.transition (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
            (g.pull.obj ((tensorRight l E Y N).obj M)) ≫
          (SemilinearSections.res (SemilinearSections.coefficientMap
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (SpTowerShriek.B l E X)
            (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h)).map (δ M N n).hom =
        (δ M N m).hom ≫ (SemilinearSections.transition (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (SpTowerShriek.B l E X) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E X) h).app
            ((tensorRight l E X (g.pull.obj N)).obj (g.pull.obj M))) ∧
      (∀ (N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)) {M M' : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)}
        (a : M ⟶ M') (n : ℕ),
        (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).map
            (g.pull.map ((tensorRight l E Y N).map a)) ≫ (δ M' N n).hom =
          (δ M N n).hom ≫ (SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).map
            ((tensorRight l E X (g.pull.obj N)).map (g.pull.map a))) ∧
      ∀ (M N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y)) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : M.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))) (y : N.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
        HEq
          ((((Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv
            _ _) ((g.ordinaryPullEvaluation n).inv.app ((tensorRight l E Y N).obj M) ≫
              (δ M N n).hom)).val.app U
                (tensorPure l E Y M N (op (n, U.unop)) x y))
          (tensorPure l E X (g.pull.obj M) (g.pull.obj N)
            (op (n, (chart f U).unop))
            (sectionAdjoint l E g (𝟙 (g.pull.obj M)) n U x)
            (sectionAdjoint l E g (𝟙 (g.pull.obj N)) n U y))
